rounds.response: Hi Alex — sorry that happened and I understand why you're concerned. This kind of brief loss of access is usually caused by an expired/invalidated session token, a short SCIM/SSO membership sync, or an admin change to board permissions (browser cache can also show a stale permission state). To reduce recurrence, please avoid using multiple accounts in the same browser, sign out and back in if it happens, and ask your org admin to confirm your board membership and any SCIM/SSO provisioning events. If you use SSO, please tell me which provider (Okta, Azure AD, etc.) so I can check recent provisioning events, and if it happens again please note the exact time so I can pull logs and escalate immediately. Thanks — I can also verify your membership or check admin logs now if you’d like.
